cohort: 865 women who underwent hysterectomies due to uterine leiomyomas
finding: History of cesarean section, presence of submucosal leiomyoma, and coexisting adenomyosis were independent risk factors for abnormal uterine bleeding in women with uterine leiomyomas.
mod_finding: This study found that a history of cesarean section was an independent risk factor for abnormal uterine bleeding in patients with uterine leiomyomas.
